objective.text: Separate named error bags for two forms rendered on the same page.

difficulty.rationale: Read the intended form's message without falling back to the default bag.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A view has an errors ViewErrorBag containing default.email="Login email required" and billing.email="Billing email invalid". What does $errors->getBag("billing")->first("email") return?

options.rationale: Selecting a bag does not merge it with every other named bag.
options.misconception: Selecting a bag does not merge it with every other named bag.

options.rationale: That message belongs to the default bag, which was not selected.
options.misconception: That message belongs to the default bag, which was not selected.

options.rationale: getBag selects billing explicitly, so first reads the email error in that bag.

options.text: An empty string because email is duplicated across bags
options.rationale: Separate bags may contain the same field name without a collision.
options.misconception: Separate bags may contain the same field name without a collision.
